adversarial.first_divergence: a4 is the first duplicate/out-of-order design trigger; a5 is subsequently late relative to the watermark

comparison.batch_mode: finite file scan; full result after file completion
comparison.stream_mode: incremental state; provisional windows; watermark closes old windows
comparison.restart: checkpointed keyed state restores exact sums/counts; stateless restart loses prior window state
comparison.latency_target: sub-2-second alert requires short processing trigger and 10-second watermark; late corrections beyond watermark are accepted as loss

measurement.throughput: events processed / elapsed seconds reported by run_task2.py
